el Guinardó — Barcelona, Spain

In detail

Local news shows a cluster of violent incidents in 2025-2026: a youth was stabbed during an attempted robbery (23 Oct 2025), three minors were arrested for stabbing an adolescent in a separate robbery attempt (12 Nov 2025), and a shooting led to four arrests (5 May 2023). Repeated container arsons have fuelled resident fear of a 'serial arsonist'. These incidents mostly involve local youths/residents rather than tourists, but the frequency of knife violence tied to theft attempts is a genuine night-time concern. Sources checked: barnadiario.com, Oct 2025-Aug 2026.
